article_title: .NET 10 架构选型：整洁架构还是垂直切片
core_theme: 为 .NET 10 Web API 在整洁架构（Clean Architecture）与垂直切片架构（Vertical Slice Architecture）之间做项目结构选择，并推荐一种混合方案：保留 Domain 与 Infrastructure 项目、去掉 Application 项目，把 endpoint / validator / handler 放进 Api 项目的 feature 文件夹，再用架构测试守住边界。
reader_takeaway: 不再二选一：把分层留作地基，把功能切片竖起来，用测试守住边界。
summary_angle: 两种互相竞争的代码组织方式（层层横铺 vs 竖着切块）收束成一座混合结构，而不是堆成一墙文字标签。

primary_subject: 一座单体的木刻／石刻建筑模型：两块厚基座上直接长出数根竖向功能柱
subject_action: 主结构稳稳立在画面中心偏右，左侧的分层堆与右侧的立柱群作为它的前身对照
composition: 等距空间 + 左右对照：左侧分层堆、右侧立柱群、中心偏右主结构为唯一强焦点，顶部留白

revision_targets: 删除两枚黑色箭头，避免读成「整洁架构 -> 混合方案 -> 垂直切片」的顺序流程（实际是并列对照 + 收束）
删除柱面上的文档/盾牌/齿轮小图标，避免界面感和无关图标堆叠，只保留石刻木纹质感
让中心混合结构成为唯一强焦点，远山松树降为低对比的支撑背景，左右两侧留白更干净
final_prompt:
Refine this wide cover illustration. Keep the strongest parts of the draft: the black-and-white woodblock printmaking rendering, the left-to-right reading order across one calm isometric scene, the three short carved Chinese labels, and the circular relationship of two competing structures resolving into one hybrid.

Change only these points:
- Remove both large black arrows completely. No arrows, no direction indicators, no pointer graphics anywhere.
- Remove all the small pale icon glyphs carved on the column faces (document, shield, gear symbols). The columns and slabs stay as plain carved stone and wood blocks with only carved line and grain texture.
- Keep exactly three visible Chinese labels and nothing else: 整洁架构 above the left layered stack, 混合方案 above the central hybrid model, 垂直切片 above the right column cluster. Four characters each, carved seal-style lettering, small and unobtrusive. Never add a title, headline, slogan, English word, sentence, caption, number, or fake diagram label.
- Make the central hybrid model clearly the single dominant focal subject: two thick foundation slabs with vertical feature columns rising directly out of them, with no extra middle layer, and the carved stone boundary fence with square seal marks enclosing it as the architecture-test boundary.
- Keep the distant ink-wash mountains and pines only as quiet, low-contrast supporting context; leave the left and right areas airy and uncluttered, with generous negative space at the top.

Preserve the metaphor: horizontal layers versus vertical slices, both merging into one hybrid structure where layers become the foundation and slices rise through it.
Primary subject stays: one carved architectural model, isometric view from a slightly high angle.
Style/medium: isometric conceptual systems scene combined with black-and-white printmaking look, carved textures, bold shadows, high contrast, poster-like but no title text. Stylized, polished, editorial, strong silhouette hierarchy. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: strictly monochrome ink black, warm paper white, mid grey, pale cream paper tone; no color accents.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no UI elements, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid robots, code rain, neon skyscrapers, floating chips, HUD overlays, purple-blue cyberpunk glow, brand logos, brand marks, arrows, and text other than the three approved labels.

Refine target: sharper carved details, cleaner composition, calmer background, better spacing between the three information beats, readable as a wide 16:9 blog cover at a glance.
